profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911, headquartered in Armonk, New York, and traded under the ticker IBM. It reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the year ended December 31, 2025, and files a 10-K with SEC CIK 0000051143. The company's OpenPages product page describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform for data governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance, available on any cloud or on-premises with a modular approach. IBM says IDC recognized it as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment. The page highlights the OpenPages GRC Canvas interactive workspace, embedded AI for classification and issue creation, API-based integration with watsonx.ai or third-party models, and an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects. IBM also states that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, saving thousands of manual hours.

IBM's AI governance products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance provides AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, documentation, and EU AI Act accelerators, and is noted as a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is an enterprise AI platform described as model-agnostic, with watsonx.governance used for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection.

IBM is associated with 458 legal exposure entries in New York.
